verdict.rationale: Plausible offers a self-hosted Community Edition (plausible-docs-2, corroborated by self-hosting users in plausible-comm-7/9) which lets an organization run Plausible on infrastructure of its own choosing, effectively giving full control over data location. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a hosted/cloud region-selection feature (e.g., EU vs US data centers) for users who don't self-host, so residency choice is only achievable via the self-hosted path, not a first-class setting in the managed product. Missing for 10: documented cloud region/residency selection option, official statement of where hosted data is stored, and any independent corroboration of region choice for SaaS customers.
